facts.name: extractor_reads_elaborated_definitions
facts.statement: rust_emit_exports collects @[rust_export] declarations and uses Lean constant bodies, not source-string matching

facts.name: surface_type_check
facts.statement: extracted SurfaceFun bodies are type-checked before Rust emission

facts.name: extract_ir_feature_tags
facts.statement: LeanRustCore.ExtractIR.functionFeatures records feature tags for compatibility reporting and validation summaries

facts.name: standard_combinator_lowering
facts.statement: recognized list/array/option/result combinators lower to checked first-order SurfaceExpr nodes

facts.name: general_pattern_compiler
facts.statement: SurfacePattern and SurfaceExpr.matchPattern represent a checked general constructor-pattern fragment for Bool, Option, Prod, and closed enums

facts.name: tail_recursion_loop_lowering
facts.statement: recognized Nat accumulator tail recursion lowers to SurfaceExpr.tailRecNat and safe Rust while loops

facts.name: list_length_structural_lowering
facts.statement: List.length lowers to SurfaceExpr.listLength and Rust Vec::len in the owned List representation

facts.name: dependent_shape_erasure
facts.statement: Sprint 10–12 dependent erasure supports Subtype/Fin/Vector runtime carriers and proof-only constructor-field erasure for Eq/True/False/And/Or/Not/Iff/Exists/LT/LE-shaped fields; non-erasable dependent computation remains rejected

facts.name: dependent_erasure_policy
facts.statement: Subtype erases to its carrier, Fin lowers to u32-shaped values, Vector lowers to Vec<T> with source-side length evidence, and proof-only structure fields are removed from safe Rust layouts when unused computationally

facts.name: proof_field_erasure
facts.statement: proof-only constructor fields are skipped during runtime payload lowering and are absent from emitted Rust structs

facts.name: exact_integer_modes
facts.statement: @[rust_nat_exact] and @[rust_int_exact] lower Lean Nat/Int boundaries to exact num_bigint BigUint/BigInt Rust values

facts.name: captured_closure_conversion
facts.statement: captured lambdas inside recognized structural combinators lower to loop bodies that close over ordinary Rust locals

facts.name: closure_converted_environments
facts.statement: captured unary lambdas lower either to immediate closure-apply SurfaceExpr nodes or to explicit first-order environment structs; escaping or stored dynamic closures remain rejected

facts.name: finite_defunctionalization
facts.statement: known finite higher-order function families lower to monomorphic enum cases plus first-order apply functions; captured values become enum payloads or explicit closure environment fields

facts.name: target_validation_snapshot

facts.name: target_fingerprint_interpreter

facts.name: ffi_boundary_exporter

facts.name: std_lowering_policy

facts.name: pure_effect_lowering

facts.name: typeclass_specialization_policy

facts.name: recursive_box_owned_data_layout
